_about: Hero/Dark campaigns on the ladder (List 35, #343): SA2's two-campaign structure wired to List 28. Two progression tracks over #146's ONE world (not save files, not restarts — #122's closed NG+ ruling untouched; a new track is a new lead in the same world, #277's part grammar in a game seat). The ladder (#271) is both campaigns' spine: hero walks it up, dark walks it down, one ledger, one world reading both. The finale gate and the interlock are built; the finale's STORY is canon, open entire.

finaleGate.gate: a finale content class (the Last Story seat) unlocks when BOTH tracks' completion facts exist in the one world
finaleGate.reads: completion, never virtue — a dark track ending in the fall (#275's fork) and one ending redeemed both count as LIVED; the ladder is read inside the finale's fiction, not by its gate
finaleGate.showForm: under #82, the shared finale airs only after both sides' arcs have run; #286's handover quotes each side's closing facts into it whole

interlock: no cross-campaign messaging layer is founded: one track's deeds surface in the other's world through the existing fact systems — #298 ambient events, #224 chronicle, #272 wanted facts, #274's info market (both directions)

ladderSpine.dark: the ladder walked DOWN — spine is #278's route beats (befriend, steal, seen-or-not, fence-or-keep, fall-or-turn) with #299 Syndicate membership as its institutional home
ladderSpine.hero: the ladder walked UP — authored beats assume the respectable world's doors; #278's parity law applies symmetrically
ladderSpine.oneSystem: List 28 entire (#269 ledger, #270 tallies, #271 steps): neither track has a private morality, a dark lead can climb (#275) and a hero lead can fall — tracks name the AUTHORED direction, the ladder keeps the ACTUAL standing

perTrackEndings: each track ends whole (#278 parity): the hero's arrival; the dark track's fall-or-redemption fork on #275. Neither is a demo for the other; neither is gated on the other existing
tracks: progression tracks over #146's shared world payload — world facts, places, dex states shared; story progress, lead records, and List 28 standing per track; switching tracks never resets or forks the world
